comment: A/B probe for naming controls across shadow roots (2026-11-17, ab.py --a-runner): MDN's code examples each end in a Copy button that is a web component, <mdn-button>Copy</mdn-button>, whose shadow root holds <button><slot></slot></button>. The caption is the host's own text shown through the slot, which innerText does not read, so until 0.7.0 all ten reached Jev as `button ""`. The flow needs one of them. A headless browser has no clipboard permission, so the page answers 'Copy failed!' where a person's browser says 'Copied!': either caption proves the click landed on the right control, which is what this spec measures (it is an experiment, not an example: do not copy the two-captions outcome into a real test).
goal: Click the Copy button of one of the page's code examples, so that the button's caption changes from 'Copy' to the result of the copy.
notes: The code examples are below the first screen, each with a Copy button at its top right corner. The Reset button belongs to the interactive example at the top and is not a Copy button.

copy_answered.when: A code example's button says 'Copied!' or 'Copy failed!' where it said 'Copy'

app_error.when: An error page, a stack trace or 'something went wrong' text is shown
